name: Agent Video Style Kit
creator: Your name

publisher.name: Cut30
publisher.attribution: Keep Cut30 / Cut30.co on the kit page, not on the creator’s videos.

units: Pixels at each format’s canvas size. Scale every coordinate, size, and outline together for other resolutions. Font weights are numeric; lineHeight is a multiplier.

font.note: Use one font for titles and captions. Install or package the chosen font in your editing engine; a browser font is not automatically available to the editor.

customization.guidance: Edit or add to this kit to match your preferences. Every change or addition must exist in both the visible HTML preview and the agent-readable kit.json.
workflow: Read kit.json before styling a video; select the matching format, not a stretched version of the other one.
Edit kit.json first. New fields or sections also need visible HTML rendering and documentation in kit-schema.md.
Run python3 kit.py validate . and python3 kit.py embed . from the kit folder. The embedded JSON must match kit.json.
Review both aspect ratios after any change. Log the change and bump kitVersion. Never keep preferences only in HTML, CSS, or comments.

9:16.label: Vertical
9:16.safeZoneNote: Conservative starting margins for vertical social videos. Check the actual platform’s UI before exporting.

rules: Keep the title in the top half and clear of the face.
Use a short hook, not a paragraph. If it wraps beyond three lines, shorten the wording.
Check the actual line boxes, padding, and safe zones after rendering.

alternative.when: Above the head, only when that area is clear of the face and the title.

rules: Place below the chin when the face fills the middle; never cover the face.
Use the alternative position only when the subject is low in frame or absent.
Keep the final caption line above y=1460 and clear of the right rail.
Use the real transcript and verify timing against the audio.

16:9.label: Landscape
16:9.safeZoneNote: Starting margins: 5% top and sides, 10% bottom. These are design defaults, not a guarantee for every player, device, or platform. Check the intended destination.

rules: Use the open upper area; keep the title clear of faces and important visuals.
Limit the hook to two lines. Shorten it before shrinking it.
Reposition within the safe area when the subject occupies the default title position.

alternative.when: Move up when lower-thirds or player controls occupy the default caption area; check the face stays clear.

rules: Center captions in the lower part of the frame, inside the safe area.
Keep the last line, including its outline, above y=972.
Keep captions clear of titles, lower-thirds, faces, and important visuals.
Use the real transcript and verify timing against the audio.

review: Choose the intended aspect ratio before placing text.
Render frames with the actual text and font; text measurement and wrapping can differ by editing engine.
Check contrast, safe areas, faces, title/caption collisions, and readability at the final display size.
Watch the full video with sound and verify every caption against the transcript and audio.

changelog.change: Safe-zone preview shading is now a neutral white veil instead of orange, so it reads on any brand colour.
Standalone Cut30 kit with separate 9:16 and 16:9 title and caption specifications.

agentContext.action: Read this JSON and the adjacent agent context, then apply all applicable style settings to the current edit.
agentContext.sync: HTML style change: update matching JSON. JSON change: update visible HTML and embedded JSON. New fields: update renderer and schema.
agentContext.discovery: Record this kit path in existing project context during setup so future sessions can find it.
